title: 👋 Welcome to r/Trench_Wrld_Official
author: trench_wrldx
selftext:
We're building TrenchWrld—an AI-powered platform focused on real-time market discovery, analytics, and visualization.

The platform is currently in public testnet, and we're looking for honest feedback from builders, AI enthusiasts, traders, and anyone interested in real-time decision systems.

If you'd be willing to spend a few minutes testing it and sharing your thoughts, we'd genuinely appreciate it. Every piece of feedback helps us improve before launch.

Thanks everyone! 🚀
